subject: addindex: remove reader ration when using global sort (#65111)
summary: Updates `expectedIngestWorkerCnt` so that when using global sort (keyed off `ReorgMeta.UseCloudStorage`) the add-index ingest pipelines use equal reader/writer worker counts (concurrency, concurrency), avoiding the avg-row-size-based reader ratio. Propagates the new flag through ingest pipeline creation and resource-tuning paths, and adds a failpoint + tests to assert `UseCloudStorage` is set and to validate the new worker-count behavior under global sort.
